assets.title: Caged Floor Work Light
assets.description: One original low portable floor-work-light visual prop. A shallow rectangular thick housing is fixed at a 15-degree upward-facing attitude inside an open low protective-looking frame. The housing has a real stepped front recess and an opaque non-emitting solid panel bearing on a complete finite internal shoulder. Two wide ground runners carry tall bored side uprights, a lower tie and a full top carrying bar. Two housing tabs carry true bored ears. Two individual continuous solid capped pins sit on finite lower bore facets, and two frame-mounted blocks meet full tab undersides as finite angle stops. Housing, ears, pins, stops, frame and runners form one connected fixed assembly. Complete clear air remains in the front recess, top handle aperture and housing-to-frame openings. Sixteen closed editable meshes and four constant opaque PBR colours. This low caged rectangular head with paired runners is original: it is not a shortened softbox, track light on a new base or repainted lantern. No cord, circuit, battery, bulb, second head, stand pole, soft cloth, track, scene or animation. Fixed static appearance only: no actual light emission, power, electrical circuit, illumination, heat dissipation, ingress protection, impact resistance, load, stability, fire or construction safety certification, adjustment, folding, manufacture or old-interface compatibility.
